source: EPC409-09 EPC List of Countries in the SEPA Schemes' Geographical Scope, version 8.0
notes: Non-EEA codes: the 11 non-EEA SEPA countries and the non-EEA territories named in section 2 of EPC409-09.
Gibraltar (GI) appears in the EPC country table; it is treated as non-EEA because it left the EU with the United Kingdom.
EPC409-09 gives FI as the BIC code of the Aland Islands; AX is accepted too because the IBAN Registry lists AX under FI.
Serbia's earliest operational readiness date is May 2026 (EPC409-09 section 3).
